metrics.description: One object per KPI metric printed on this page (an empty list if the page prints none).

label.description: The metric's name exactly as printed on the page, including its breakdown member, copied character for character.

member.description: The breakdown member alone (industry, geography, segment, class or basis), or null for a company-wide metric.

value.description: The number as printed on this page (negative for a fall), or null for a phrase with no number.

unit.description: The unit as printed, or null.
